title: The Reactor Meltdown
logline: A station's reactor is melting down after a rigged inspection, and the engineer needs a pilot to extract the safety inspector's black box to prove they were bribed.

roles.description: Covered in grease, exhausted, refusing to let the station die.
Smug, well-dressed, already packing their bags.
A massive power core venting radioactive gas.
The bureaucratic agency overseeing station safety.

public_situation: The {role:failing_reactor} is entering critical meltdown, and the {role:safety_board} has ordered a full evacuation.
private_truth: The inspector intentionally failed the cooling system to force the station to buy a replacement from a corporate backer. They are fleeing before the core blows.

beats.public_change: The reactor's primary cooling loop fails completely.

missions.reason: The engineer begs the pilot to buy emergency coolant and deliver it to the reactor to buy them time.
missions.private_fact: The engineer is staying behind in the irradiated zone to try and fix it.

beats.public_change: The inspector boards their ship and prepares to jump away.

missions.reason: The inspector hires the pilot to run a final scan of the reactor to legally certify it was "operator error".
missions.private_fact: The scan reveals the cooling loop was physically severed, not burned out.

beats.public_change: The engineer realizes the sabotage and demands the pilot stop the inspector.

missions.reason: The engineer pays the pilot to destroy the inspector's ship and recover its black box.
missions.private_fact: The inspector hails the pilot, offering a massive bribe to let them jump away.

resolutions.summary: The black box proves the sabotage. The inspector is killed, and emergency crews rush in to save the reactor.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot shot down a corrupt inspector and saved a station from a meltdown.

resolutions.summary: The inspector jumps away. The reactor goes critical, and the engineer dies trying to stop it. The pilot is rich but infamous.
The station is abandoned and slowly melts down. The inspector escapes safely.

loose_threads.detail: The inspector's accounts show massive deposits from a rival station operator.
The replacement cooling unit already had shipping labels printed two weeks before the failure.

radio_hooks: Evacuation ordered as {role:failing_reactor} approaches critical mass.
{role:safety_board} promises full investigation into reactor failure.

voice_direction.desperate_engineer: Breathless, angry, speaks extremely loudly over the alarms.
voice_direction.corrupt_inspector: Smooth, unbothered, speaks as if they are already on vacation.
